prompts.prompt: Which part of your life currently feels most aligned with who you want to be?
What kind of support helps you feel capable rather than rescued?
Which belief about relationships have you changed since we became a couple?
When life becomes uncertain, what do you most need to remain predictable between us?
What does a sincere repair look like after one of us causes hurt?
Which personal dream needs room to remain yours, even inside our shared future?
What do you wish people understood about the way you make difficult decisions?
When have you felt most trusted by me?
What fear becomes smaller when you can name it out loud?
Which boundary helps you show up more generously in our relationship?
What does enough look like to you in work, money, rest, or achievement?
Which difference between us has taught you something valuable?
What part of growing older together feels exciting rather than frightening?
When do you feel responsible for emotions that are not actually yours to carry?
Which family pattern would you like us to keep, and which would you like us to rewrite?
What truth about yourself took a long time to accept?
What makes a disagreement feel safe enough to continue?
Which sacrifice in a relationship feels loving, and which kind creates resentment?
What do you hope remains curious and unfinished about you?
When have we acted most like a team under pressure?
What does emotional privacy mean to you inside a close partnership?
Which future decision deserves more conversation before it becomes urgent?
What kind of legacy would you like our relationship to leave in other people's lives?
What is one way love has made you more yourself rather than less?
